_note: Per-platform posting cadence used when a social-media-manager draft is approved in the review UI. See social-publisher.js. Set enabled:false for platforms that need media until carousel/pin assets are wired in.

instagram._disabled_reason: Requires media (carousel images). Flip enabled:true once carousel creative is wired into the social-publisher media field.

pinterest._disabled_reason: Requires media (pin image). Flip enabled:true once pin creative is wired into the social-publisher media field.
